title: fix(search): reject empty-match regex patterns
body:
Summary
Reject regex patterns that can match the empty string to avoid unstable search/replace behavior.
Add regression coverage for empty-match regex queries.

Test plan
 [x] packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts
 [x] tsc --noEmit

commits_at_first_review.message:
fix(search): reject empty-match regex patterns

Prevent zero-length regex queries from producing unstable search results and add coverage for the empty-match guard.
